Pure R implementation of the ubiquitous log4j package. It offers hierarchic loggers, multiple handlers per logger, level based filtering, space handling in messages and custom formatting.

name: r-logging
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.10-111" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-logging
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/logging_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/logging/logging_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 019bd366f14c9702378b74d0f2babd14497448f8792ccd45d1846cddd3104f59

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('logging')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('logging')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/WLOGSolutions/r-logging
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  summary: Pure R implementation of the ubiquitous log4j package. It offers hierarchic loggers,
    multiple handlers per logger, level based filtering, space handling in messages
    and custom formatting.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
